children: CION Investment’s portfolio company David’s Bridal signed a non-binding letter of intent for Pearl to combine with K&F Growth Acquisition Corp. II and become a standalone public company.
The proposed transaction would separate Pearl, David’s Bridal’s AI-powered wedding platform, and values it at approximately $350 million in pro forma enterprise value.
The LOI contemplates a $75 million PIPE, including a proposed $25 million anchor investment from CION, subject to definitive documentation.
Pearl forecasts 2026 EBITDA margins above 30% and revenue growth exceeding 100% in 2027 to more than $85 million, with positive free cash flow in both years.
The parties currently expect to close in the first half of 2027; the deal remains subject to definitive agreements, approvals and other conditions.
David’s Bridal stores are expected to operate as usual, with no disruption to appointments, products, services or the guest experience.
